name: @mcp-apps-kit/monorepo
description: Unified MCP Apps Builder SDK - Build MCP apps for any MCP Apps-compatible host from a single codebase

scripts.release:version:patch: nx release version patch -p @mcp-apps-kit/core,@mcp-apps-kit/ui,@mcp-apps-kit/ui-react,@mcp-apps-kit/ui-react-builder,@mcp-apps-kit/create-app,@mcp-apps-kit/testing && pnpm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json
scripts.release:version:minor: nx release version minor -p @mcp-apps-kit/core,@mcp-apps-kit/ui,@mcp-apps-kit/ui-react,@mcp-apps-kit/ui-react-builder,@mcp-apps-kit/create-app,@mcp-apps-kit/testing && pnpm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json
scripts.release:version:major: nx release version major -p @mcp-apps-kit/core,@mcp-apps-kit/ui,@mcp-apps-kit/ui-react,@mcp-apps-kit/ui-react-builder,@mcp-apps-kit/create-app,@mcp-apps-kit/testing && pnpm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json
